workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Face Move

bounded_scope: unique positive-Z top planar face selected by geometry rule rather than FaceN
selected top face plus four adjacent planar side faces replaced through BRepTools_ReShape
signed displacement persisted as OLE_DeltaMM float with explicit mm unit metadata
80 mm to 100 mm authoritative width rebuild with face selector re-resolution
single-solid validity and exact width/depth preservation
expected height and prism-volume readback after push/pull
collapse or inversion move rejected deterministically before subshape replacement
FCStd persistence and separate push/pull STEP export
FreeCAD reopen preserves OLE IDs operation selector authority signed displacement and solid geometry
typed Blender display derivative for pushed R002 geometry with FCStd/STEP hashes
Blender save/reopen preserves display-only authority and operation provenance
invalidation_rule: Material changes to selector semantics, face replacement adjacency logic, sew/fix normalization, tested displacement cases, FreeCAD/OCCT version, Blender version or readback authority require a new receipt.
authority_note: This is bounded face-level B-Rep normal movement on one prismatic topology. It is materially closer to direct face editing than parameter rebuild, but it does not establish arbitrary/general push-pull or P0-B PASS.
